verses.geez:
ወሰምዐ ፡ ዮቶር ፡ ሠዋዒ ፡ ዘእምድያም ፡ ሐሙሁ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ለሕዝቡ ፡
                  ወአውፅኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ እምግብጽ ።
verses.translation: And Jothor the priest of Madiam, the father-in-law of Moses, heard of all that the Lord did to his people Israel; for the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt.

translations.lxx: And Jothor the priest of Madiam, the father-in-law of Moses, heard of all that the Lord did to his people Israel; for the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt.
translations.kjv: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;
translations.ron: Auzind însă Ietro, preotul din Madian, socrul lui Moise, de toate câte făcuse Dumnezeu pentru Moise şi pentru Israel, poporul Său, când a scos Domnul pe Israel din Egipt,

verses.geez: ወነሥአ ፡ ዮቶር ፡ ሐሙሁ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ [ሲፕ]ራሃ ፡ ብእሲቶ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ እምዘ ፡ ኀደጋ ፤
verses.translation: And Jothor the father-in-law of Moses, took Sepphora the wife of Moses after she had been sent away,

translations.lxx: And Jothor the father-in-law of Moses, took Sepphora the wife of Moses after she had been sent away,
translations.kjv: Then Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back,
translations.ron: A luat Ietro, socrul lui Moise, pe Sefora, femeia lui Moise, care fusese trimisă înainte de acesta acasă,

verses.geez: [ወ፪ደቂቆ ፡] ወስሙ ፡ ለወልደ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለአሐዱ ፡ ጌርሳም ፡ ወይቤ ፡ እስመ ፡ ፈላሲ ፡ አነ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ባዕድ ፡
verses.translation: and her two sons: the name of the one was Gersam, his father saying, I was a sojourner in a strange land;—

translations.lxx: and her two sons: the name of the one was Gersam, his father saying, I was a sojourner in a strange land;—
translations.kjv: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
translations.ron: Şi pe cei doi fii ai ei, din care unul se chema Gherşom, pentru că Moise îşi zisese: "Rătăcit sunt eu în pământ străin",

verses.geez: ወስሙ ፡ ለካልእ ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ኤልያዛር ፡ [ወይቤ ፡] ፈጣሪ ፡ ዘአቡየ ፡ ረዳኢየ ፡ ወአድኅነኒ ፡ እምእዴሁ ፡ ለፈርዖን ።
verses.translation: and the name of the second Eliezer, saying, For the God of my father is my helper, and he has rescued me out of the hand of Pharao.

translations.lxx: and the name of the second Eliezer, saying, For the God of my father is my helper, and he has rescued me out of the hand of Pharao.
translations.kjv: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
translations.ron: Iar pe altul îl chema Eliezer, pentru că-şi zisese el: "Dumnezeul părinţilor mei mi-a fost ajutor şi m-a scăpat de sabia lui Faraon!"

verses.geez:
ወመጽአ ፡ ዮቶር ፡ ሐሙሁ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወደቁ ፡ ወብእሲቱ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ገዳመ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኀደሩ ፡ ጕንደ ፡ ደብር ፡
                  ዘእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Jothor the father-in-law of Moses, and his sons and his wife, went forth to Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped on the mount of God.

translations.lxx: And Jothor the father-in-law of Moses, and his sons and his wife, went forth to Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped on the mount of God.
translations.kjv: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
translations.ron: Şi a venit Ietro, socrul lui Moise, cu fiii acestuia şi cu femeia lui, la Moise în pustie, unde-şi aşezase el tabăra, la muntele lui Dumnezeu.

verses.geez: ወይቤልዎ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ዮቶር ፡ ሐሙከ ፡ ይበጽሕ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ወብእሲትከ ፡ ወክልኤሆሙ ፡ ደቂቅከ ።
verses.translation: And it was told Moses, saying, Behold, thy father-in-law Jothor is coming to thee, and thy wife and two sons with him.

translations.lxx: And it was told Moses, saying, Behold, thy father-in-law Jothor is coming to thee, and thy wife and two sons with him.
translations.kjv: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
translations.ron: Atunci el a trimis vorbă lui Moise, zicând: "Iată, eu, Ietro, socrul tău, şi femeia ta şi cei doi fii ai ei împreună cu ea venim la tine".

verses.geez: ወወፅአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወተቀበሎ ፡ ለሐሙሁ ፡ ወአምኆ ፡ ወሰአሞ ፡ ወተአምኁ ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ ፡ ወቦኡ ፡ ትዕይንተ ።
verses.translation: And Moses went forth to meet his father-in-law, and did him reverence, and kissed him, and they embraced each other, and he brought them into the tent.

translations.lxx: And Moses went forth to meet his father-in-law, and did him reverence, and kissed him, and they embraced each other, and he brought them into the tent.
translations.kjv: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
translations.ron: Deci a ieşit Moise în întâmpinarea socrului său, s-a plecat înaintea lui şi l-a sărutat. Iar după ce s-au binecuvântat unul pe altul, au intrat în cort.

verses.geez:
ወዜነዎ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለሐሙሁ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘገብሮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ወለግብጽ ፡ በእንተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወኵሎ ፡
                  ሕማመ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ሐሙ ፡ በፍኖት ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ አድኀኖሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Moses related to his father-in-law all things that the Lord did to Pharao and all the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the labour that had befallen them in the way, and that the Lord had rescued them out of the hand of Pharao, and out of the hand of the Egyptians.

translations.lxx: And Moses related to his father-in-law all things that the Lord did to Pharao and all the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the labour that had befallen them in the way, and that the Lord had rescued them out of the hand of Pharao, and out of the hand of the Egyptians.
translations.kjv: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.
translations.ron: Apoi a povestit Moise socrului său toate câte a făcut Domnul cu Faraon şi cu toţi Egiptenii pentru Israel, toate suferinţele ce le-au întâlnit ei în cale şi cum i-a izbăvit Domnul din mâinile lui Faraon şi din mâinile Egiptenilor.

verses.geez: ወደንገፀ ፡ ዮቶር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአድኀኖሙ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወእምእደ ፡ ፈርዖን ።
verses.translation: And Jothor was amazed at all the good things which the Lord did to them, forasmuch as he rescued them out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of Pharao.

translations.lxx: And Jothor was amazed at all the good things which the Lord did to them, forasmuch as he rescued them out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of Pharao.
translations.kjv: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
translations.ron: Iar Ietro s-a bucurat de toate binefacerile ce a arătat Domnul lui Israel, când l-a izbăvit din mâna Egiptenilor şi din mâna lui Faraon.

verses.geez: ወይቤ ፡ ዮቶር ፡ ቡሩክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘአድኀነ ፡ ሕዝቦ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወእምእደ ፡ ፈርዖን ።
verses.translation: And Jothor said, Blessed be the Lord, because he has rescued them out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of Pharao.

translations.lxx: And Jothor said, Blessed be the Lord, because he has rescued them out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of Pharao.
translations.kjv: And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
translations.ron: şi a zis Ietro: "Binecuvântat este Domnul, Care v-a izbăvit din mâinile Egiptenilor şi din mâna tui Faraon, Cel ce a izbăvit pe poporul acesta din stăpânirea Egiptenilor.

verses.geez: እምይእዜ ፡ አእመርኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ አማልክት ፡ በበይነዝ ፡ ተኰነኑ ፡ ሎሙ ።
verses.translation: Now know I that the Lord is great above all gods, because of this, wherein they attacked them.

translations.lxx: Now know I that the Lord is great above all gods, because of this, wherein they attacked them.
translations.kjv: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.
translations.ron: Acum am cunoscut şi eu că Domnul este mare peste toţi dumnezeii, pentru că a smerit pe aceştia".

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ ዮቶር ፡ ሐሙሁ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወገብረ ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወመጽአ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወሊቃነ ፡
                  ሕዝብ ፡ ዘእስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ይብልዑ ፡ ኅብስተ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሐመ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Jothor the father-in-law of Moses took whole burnt-offerings and sacrifices for God, for Aaron and all the elders of Israel came to eat bread with the father-in-law of Moses before God.

translations.lxx: And Jothor the father-in-law of Moses took whole burnt-offerings and sacrifices for God, for Aaron and all the elders of Israel came to eat bread with the father-in-law of Moses before God.
translations.kjv: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father in law before God.
translations.ron: Apoi Ietro, socrul lui Moise, a adus lui Dumnezeu ardere de tot şi jertfă. şi au venit Aaron şi toţi bătrânii lui Israel să mănânce pâine cu socrul lui Moise înaintea lui Dumnezeu.

verses.geez: ወአመ ፡ ሳኒታ ፡ ነበረ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ይኰንን ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ወይጸንሕ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ሙሴሃ ፡ እምነግህ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሰርክ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass after the morrow that Moses sat to judge the people, and all the people stood by Moses from morning till evening.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass after the morrow that Moses sat to judge the people, and all the people stood by Moses from morning till evening.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.
translations.ron: Iar a doua zi a şezut Moise să judece poporul şi a stat poporul înaintea lui Moise de dimineaţă până seara.

verses.geez:
ወርእየ ፡ ዮቶር ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይገብር ፡ በላዕለ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ዮቶር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ምንትኑዝ ፡ ዘትገብር ፡ በሕዝብ
                  ፡ ባሕቲትከ ፡ ትነብር ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ይቀውም ፡ እምነግህ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሰርክ ።
verses.translation: And Jothor having seen all that Moses did to the people, says, What is this that thou doest to the people? wherefore sittest thou alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning till evening?

translations.lxx: And Jothor having seen all that Moses did to the people, says, What is this that thou doest to the people? wherefore sittest thou alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning till evening?
translations.kjv: And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?
translations.ron: Văzând Ietro, socrul lui Moise, tot ceea ce făcea el cu poporul, i-a zis: "Ce faci tu cu poporul? De ce stai tu singur şi tot poporul tău stă înaintea ta de dimineaţă până seara?"

verses.geez: ወይቤ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለሐሙሁ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይመጽእ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወይስእል ፡ ፍትሐ ፡ በኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Moses says to his father-in-law, Because the people come to me to seek judgment from God.

translations.lxx: And Moses says to his father-in-law, Because the people come to me to seek judgment from God.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:
translations.ron: Iar Moise a zis către socrul său: "Poporul vine la mine să ceară judecată de la Dumnezeu.

verses.geez:
እምከመ ፡ ተጋአዙሂ ፡ ይመጽኡ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ እፍትሖሙ ፡ አስተናጺሕየ ፡ ለለአሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወሕጎ
                  ።
verses.translation: For whenever there is a dispute among them, and they come to me, I give judgment upon each, and I teach them the ordinances of God and his law.

translations.lxx: For whenever there is a dispute among them, and they come to me, I give judgment upon each, and I teach them the ordinances of God and his law.
translations.kjv: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.
translations.ron: Când se ivesc între ei neînţelegeri, vin la mine şi judec pe fiecare şi-i învăţ poruncile lui Dumnezeu şi legile Lui".

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ ሐሙሁ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ አኮ ፡ ርቱዕ ፡ ዘአንተ ፡ ትገብር ፡ ዝነገር ፡ ዐቢይ ።
verses.translation: And the father-in-law of Moses said to him, Thou dost not this thing rightly,

translations.lxx: And the father-in-law of Moses said to him, Thou dost not this thing rightly,
translations.kjv: And Moses’ father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.
translations.ron: Iar socrul lui Moise a zis către acesta: "Ceea ce faci, nu faci bine.

verses.geez:
ሕማመ ፡ ተሐምም ፡ አንተ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዘሀሎ ፡ ምስሌከ ፤ ይከብደከ ፡ [ዝቃል ፡] ወኢትክል ፡ ባሕቲትከ ፡
                  ገቢሮተ ።
verses.translation: thou wilt wear away with intolerable weariness, both thou and all this people which is with thee: this thing is hard, thou wilt not be able to endure it thyself alone.

translations.lxx: thou wilt wear away with intolerable weariness, both thou and all this people which is with thee: this thing is hard, thou wilt not be able to endure it thyself alone.
translations.kjv: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
translations.ron: Căci te vei prăpădi şi tu, şi poporul acesta, care este cu tine. E grea pentru tine sarcina aceasta şi nu o vei putea împlini singur.

verses.geez:
ወይእዜኒ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ወአነ ፡ አመክረከ ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ የሀሉ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ወኩኖሙ ፡ አንተ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ በኀበ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወታብትክ ፡ ቃሎሙ ፡ በኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: Now then hearken to me, and I will advise thee, and God shall be with thee: be thou to the people in the things pertaining to God, and thou shalt bring their matters to God.

translations.lxx: Now then hearken to me, and I will advise thee, and God shall be with thee: be thou to the people in the things pertaining to God, and thou shalt bring their matters to God.
translations.kjv: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:
translations.ron: Acum dar ascultă-mă pe mine: Am să-ţi dau un sfat şi Dumnezeu să fie cu tine! Fii tu pentru popor mijlocitor înaintea lui Dumnezeu şi înfăţişează la Dumnezeu nevoile lui.

verses.geez:
ወአስምዖሙ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወሕጎ ፡ ወትዜንዎሙ ፡ ፍኖቶ ፡ በእለ ፡ [የሐውሩ ፡] በውስቴቶሙ ፡ ወግብረ ፡
                  ዘይገብሩ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt testify to them the ordinances of God and his law, and thou shalt shew to them the ways in which they shall walk, and the works which they shall do.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt testify to them the ordinances of God and his law, and thou shalt shew to them the ways in which they shall walk, and the works which they shall do.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
translations.ron: Învaţă-i poruncile şi legile Lui; arată-le calea Lui, pe care trebuie să meargă, şi faptele ce trebuie să facă.

verses.geez:
ወአንተሂ ፡ ለሊከ ፡ ምክር ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ዕደወ ፡ ጻድቃነ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጸልኡ ፡
                  ትዕቢተ ፡ ወሢም ፡ ሎሙ ፡ መኰንነ ፡ ለ፲፻ወለምእት ፡ ወለኀምሳ ፡ ወለዐሠርቱ ።
verses.translation: And do thou look out for thyself out of all the people able men, fearing God, righteous men, hating pride, and thou shalt set over the people captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens.

translations.lxx: And do thou look out for thyself out of all the people able men, fearing God, righteous men, hating pride, and thou shalt set over the people captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens.
translations.kjv: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
translations.ron: Iar mai departe alege-ţi din tot poporul oameni drepţi şi cu frica lui Dumnezeu; oameni drepţi, care urăsc lăcomia, şi-i pune căpetenii peste mii, căpetenii peste sute, căpetenii peste cincizeci, căpetenii peste zeci.

verses.geez:
ወይኰንኑ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሰዐተ ፡ ወቃለ ፡ ዘዐጸቦሙ ፡ ያዕርጉ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ወቀሊለ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ይኰንኑ ፡
                  ወያቀልሉከ ፡ ወያርድኡከ ።
verses.translation: And they shall judge the people at all times, and the too burdensome matter they shall bring to thee, but they shall judge the smaller cases; so they shall relieve thee and help thee.

translations.lxx: And they shall judge the people at all times, and the too burdensome matter they shall bring to thee, but they shall judge the smaller cases; so they shall relieve thee and help thee.
translations.kjv: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.
translations.ron: Aceştia să judece poporul în toată vremea: pricinile grele să le aducă la tine, iar pe cele mici să le judece ei toate. Uşurează-ţi povara şi ei să o poarte împreună cu tine!

verses.geez:
ወዝ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ ያኄይለከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወትክል ፡ ኰንኖ ፡ ወዝሕዝብ ፡ ይግባእ ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ምንባሪሁ ፡ በፍሥሓ ።
verses.translation: If thou wilt do this thing, God shall strengthen thee, and thou shalt be able to attend, and all this people shall come with peace into their own place.

translations.lxx: If thou wilt do this thing, God shall strengthen thee, and thou shalt be able to attend, and all this people shall come with peace into their own place.
translations.kjv: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
translations.ron: De vei face lucrul acesta şi te va întări şi Dumnezeu cu porunci, vei putea să faci faţă, şi tot poporul acesta va ajunge cu pace la locul său".

verses.geez: ወሰምዐ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ሐሙሁ ፡ ወገብረ ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤሎ ።
verses.translation: And Moses hearkened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did whatsoever he said to him.

translations.lxx: And Moses hearkened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did whatsoever he said to him.
translations.kjv: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
translations.ron: Şi a ascultat Moise glasul socrului său şi a făcut toate câte i-a zis.

verses.geez:
ወኀርየ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ዕደወ ፡ ዘይክል ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወሤመ ፡ ውስቴቶሙ ፡ መኰንነ ፡ ለ፲፻ወዘ፻ወዘ፶ወዘ፲
                  ።
verses.translation: And Moses chose out able men out of all Israel, and he made them captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties and captains of tens over the people.

translations.lxx: And Moses chose out able men out of all Israel, and he made them captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties and captains of tens over the people.
translations.kjv: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
translations.ron: A ales deci Moise din tot Israelul oameni destoinici şi i-a pus căpetenii în popor: peste mii, peste sute, peste cincizeci, peste zeci.

verses.geez:
ወይኰንኑ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ኵላ ፡ ሰዐተ ፡ ወዘዐጸቦሙ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ ያዕርጉ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወቀሊለ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ እሙንቱ
                  ፡ ይፍትሑ ።
verses.translation: And they judged the people at all times; and every too burdensome matter they brought to Moses, but every light matter they judged themselves.

translations.lxx: And they judged the people at all times; and every too burdensome matter they brought to Moses, but every light matter they judged themselves.
translations.kjv: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
translations.ron: Şi judecau aceştia poporul în toată vremea; toate pricinile grele le aduceau la Moise, iar pe cele mai uşoare le judecau ei toate.

verses.geez: ወፈነወ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ሐማሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድሩ ፡ [ወ]ኅለፈ ።
verses.translation: And Moses dismissed his father-in-law, and he returned to his own land.

translations.lxx: And Moses dismissed his father-in-law, and he returned to his own land.
translations.kjv: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
translations.ron: După aceea a petrecut Moise pe socrul său şi acesta s-a dus în ţara lui.
